archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) infused with Neo-Brutalist elements

brand_identity.name: KHATTA-MEETHA
brand_identity.concept: Tension between strict owners (Khatta) and comfort-seeking tenants (Meetha). High contrast, bold, no-nonsense but highly flavorful Indian market approach.

spacing_and_layout.generous_padding: Use p-8 to p-12 for main sections. Containers with borders MUST have p-6 or p-8.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grids with heavy gap-6 or gap-8. Direct children only for grid items.

components.buttons: border-2 border-zinc-950 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-6 py-3 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2
components.cards: bg-white border-2 border-zinc-950 p-6 flex flex-col shadow-[4px_4px_0px_rgba(9,9,11,1)]
components.inputs: bg-white border-2 border-zinc-950 rounded-none p-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF4D00] focus:outline-none transition-all
components.badges: px-3 py-1 border-2 border-zinc-950 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider shadow-[2px_2px_0px_rgba(9,9,11,1)]

hero_background.description: Spacious modern living room featuring brick walls, teal sofa, and red rug. Use as hero visual or premium featured property.

property_listing_1.description: Bright and empty modern room with hardwood floors. Use for property cards and interior showcases.

testimonial_family.description: Joyful family of four enjoying time together. Perfect for the 'Meetha' (tenant) marketing sections.

location_city.description: Urban balcony with city skyline view. Use for location-based search or map preview section.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='search-submit-button', data-testid='property-card-1'). This is CRITICAL for automated testing.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Apply the Neo-Brutalist High-Contrast theme strictly. No soft, blurry drop-shadows or rounded corners. Everything must feel like architectural blocks.

2. For Shadcn UI components, you MUST heavily customize them to strip out the 'Vercel look' (remove soft rounded corners, replace subtle shadows with harsh solid black drop-shadows, use thick borders).
3. Use .js extensions for all files, absolutely NO TypeScript (.tsx).
4. For the Map view (Leaflet), apply a high-contrast style or keep the UI overlays around the map fully brutalist (thick borders, solid colors).
5. Ensure hover states on buttons invert colors or push the button down (active state) to flatten the solid shadow, simulating physical buttons.
6. Do NOT use standard Bootstrap/Tailwind columns. Use asymmetrical grids (Bento Box style) where possible for landing page.
7. Implement all media URLs provided. Do not use generic placeholders like via.placeholder.com.
8. Navigation headers should have a solid bottom border (border-b-2 border-zinc-950) with high contrast.
9. Use lucide-react for icons, but size them boldly (e.g., stroke-width 2.5 or 3) to match the typography.
